summary: Apply psychology models to motivation, feedback, and team behaviour. Explore the five-day leadership psychology course and its practical exercises.
lede: Leadership psychology helps supervisors, people managers and HR practitioners interpret workplace behaviour before choosing how to respond. This foundation course builds practical skills in observing behaviour, checking assumptions with Attribution Theory, diagnosing motivation through Self-Determination Theory, and planning feedback or team responses, including when hybrid communication affects trust and connection.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people whose daily work involves guiding others, interpreting team behaviour, or shaping workplace responses. It suits you if you want a practical foundation in applying psychology to leadership situations.
modules: Big Five Personality and Leadership Patterns
Social Identity Theory and Team Belonging
prerequisites: Prerequisites: no prior psychology knowledge is specified. Bring a workplace leadership situation for case-based application. Coding or programming is not required.
